name: Material Devotion
body:
You are restricted to using magical objects created with your deity’s domains in mind.

Prerequisite: Access to domains

Effect: You may only use spell-trigger items (wands and staffs) that cast spells on your domain spell lists. Other spell-trigger items fail you.
